title: Best habit tracker
body:
I started out using Streaks. When I outgrew streaks, I tried out a bunch of different habit trackers. The only one that came close to my needs was grit. I have only two suggestions for improvement: 

First, I would like the widgets to have their own sorting settings. That way I could have only uncompleted habits on the home screen while easily being able to manage all habits in the app. 

Second, I would like a sort setting that shows all habits, even if they’re not scheduled on that day. You have to jump through some hoops to be able to access the settings for a habit that’s not scheduled on that day. 

Thanks for a great app! I love it!
author: __FL__

title: Fantastic app!
body:
I love Grit. I started out with Streaks, and when I outgrew that I tried maybe 10 different habit trackers. And Grit is the one that fits me best. It does nearly everything I want it to do perfectly. 

My only wish is that the home screen widgets could have separate sort settings from the app. Then the app would be perfect. That would allow me to have my "ToDo" setup on the home screen, and then easily be able to change miscklicks in the app.
